description:
All tree works due to massively shaded garden and part of general maintenance of trees.

T1 Hawthorn (under canopy of Large Oak left side of house)

T2	Hawthorn (Right side of house next to H1) 

Fell both trees as close to ground level as possible. Tree canopies are in decline and almost bare, replace with a more suitable, healthy tree

H1 (right side of house)	Leyland Cypress	(Hedge) Reduce height of hedge by up to 2 metre/s and trim all sides of hedge by 1m, creating flat top and sides.  Works due to excessive shade casting on side of house.

T3-T4 (rear left grd)	Both trees under Canopy of large Oaks 
Bay & Strawberry Tree	Fell both trees as close to ground level as possible. Strawberry tree is small and the top has snapped out previously and of low amenity value. Bay is blocking light to vegetable patch.
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
